blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A drunk driver allegedly fell asleep at the wheel of his SUV and ran over two pedestrians walking on the other side of the road killing one and severely injuring another one. The fatal road incident happened at past 2:50 a.m., today, along General Maxilom Avenue in Cebu City. The driver did not stop after hitting the two pedestrians, a 27-year-old woman, a resident of Barangay Lahug, Cebu City, and a 56-year-old American national.
